description:
**Job Description**
 The Building Technology Systems Design Intern will support the design and engineering of Information and Communications Technology (ICT), Electronic Security Systems (ESS), Audiovisual (AV), and Building Automation Systems (BAS/BMS) for commercial, residential, hospitality, healthcare, educational, and mixed\-use developments.
   

  

 The intern will work closely with multidisciplinary design teams and gain practical experience in engineering design, BIM coordination, technical documentation, specifications, and construction support services throughout various project stages from concept design to construction administration.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**ICT Systems**
* Assist in the design and documentation of:
+ Structured Cabling Systems (Copper \& Fiber)
+ Telecommunications Rooms (TER/TR)
+ Data Centers and Server Rooms
+ LAN/WAN Infrastructure
+ Wireless Networks (Wi\-Fi)
+ IP Telephony Systems

* Prepare ICT layouts, riser diagrams, rack elevations, and equipment schedules.
* Support cable pathway planning including conduits, cable trays, trunking, and containment systems.


**Electronic Security Systems**
* Assist in the design of:
+ CCTV Surveillance Systems
+ Access Control Systems
+ Intrusion Detection Systems
+ Intercom Systems
+ Visitor Management Systems
+ Security Management Systems

* Prepare security device layouts, schematics, and equipment schedules.
* Support coverage studies and device placement coordination.


**Audiovisual Systems**
* Assist in the design of:
+ Meeting Room AV Systems
+ Boardroom AV Solutions
+ Conference and Training Facilities
+ Digital Signage Systems
+ Public Address Systems
+ Background Music Systems

* Support preparation of single\-line diagrams, signal flow diagrams, and equipment lists.


**Building Automation Systems**
* Assist in the development of:
+ Building Management Systems (BMS)
+ Smart Building Solutions
+ IoT Integration Infrastructure
+ System Integration Architecture

* Support preparation of network architecture and integration drawings.


**BIM and Design Documentation**
* Assist in developing engineering drawings using AutoCAD and Revit.
* Support BIM model development and multidisciplinary coordination.
* Participate in clash detection reviews and model validation exercises.
* Prepare technical reports, presentations, schedules, and engineering documentation.
* Assist in maintaining drawing registers and document control procedures.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
 Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's Degree in:
   

  

* Electronics \& Communication Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Telecommunications Engineering
* Computer Engineering
* Information Technology
* Building Services Engineering
* Related Engineering Discipline


**Technical Skills**
**Preferred Knowledge**
* Structured Cabling Systems
* Computer Networks and Telecommunications
* ELV and Security Systems
* Audiovisual Technologies
* Building Management Systems
* Smart Building Technologies
* BIM and Digital Engineering Concepts


**Software Skills**
* AutoCAD
* Revit (Preferred)
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Bluebeam or PDF Markup Tools (Preferred)


**Professional Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.


**Learning Opportunities**
 During the internship, the candidate will gain exposure to:
   

  

* ICT Infrastructure Design
* Security Systems Design
* Audiovisual Systems Engineering
* Building Management Systems
* Smart Building Technologies
* BIM Coordination and Revit Modelling
* Design Documentation and Specifications
* Industry Standards and Best Practices including BICSI, TIA, ISO/IEC, IEC, NFPA and local authority requirements.


**Career Path**
* Successful candidates may be considered for future positions as Graduate Engineer based on the performance and availability at the end of internship period.


**Note:** 
 This internship is intended to provide hands\-on exposure to the design and delivery of technology systems within the built environment, while developing the technical, coordination, and professional skills required for a career in engineering consultancy.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Overview About Ripik.AI**
 Ripik.AI is an Accel\-backed Applied AI company building computer vision and process\-optimization agents for the world's largest industrial enterprises across steel, cement, aluminum, chemicals, pharma, and power. Our Vision AI platform acts as an automated pair of eyes on the shop floor — monitoring materials, equipment, and processes 24/7 with 95%\+ accuracy, eliminating human error, and delivering measurable gains in throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and safety. We work with marquee customers including Tata Steel, JSW, ArcelorMittal, Vedanta, Godrej \& Boyce, Grasim, Holcim, and Jindal Steel, and are scaling globally across India, the Middle East, Europe, and North America. As we move into our next phase of growth, we are building the operating backbone that will take Ripik from a high\-velocity scale\-up to a category\-defining global industrial AI company.Ripik.AI is one of India's few AI product start\-ups to be a partner to GCP, Azure, and AWS, and is the AI partner of choice for CII, ICC, and NASSCOM.
   

  

 The Role. We are looking for a sharp, hands\-on Finance Manager to own the finance engine at Ripik.AI. You will run the full accounting and compliance backbone of a fast\-scaling industrial AI company — from month\-end close and MIS to statutory compliance and cash flow management. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who has built finance in a 0\-to\-1 startup before and is excited to do it again, alongside a leadership team scaling Ripik into a category\-defining global business
   

  

**Job Overview:** 
 We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and support our growing network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of networking protocols, hardware, and software, along with excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, configure, and maintain network hardware and software components, including routers, switches, firewalls, Internet connect cameras, NVRs (network video recorder), SAN/NAS (storage) and IOT devices and load balancers. Able to configure both hardware and software routers and firewalls
* Set up networking required for Edge devices and data centres and cloud
* Create and maintain virtual LANs (VLAN) in on\-premises and VPCs across multiple clouds
* Implement and maintain network security, including setting up firewalls, managing VPNs, and implementing access controls
* Establish connectivity between on\-premises systems and cloud based virtual machines and other cloud services
* Able to connect hybrid systems (on\-premises, multi\-cloud) and ensure smooth traffic between trusted endpoints via IP whitelisting, VPN tunnelling, etc.
* Work with plant teams (OT and automation systems) to connect OT network (where RTSP cameras and other data sources such as sensors are located) and IT network (where apps are hosted either on the premise as servers/PCs or in Cloud as VMs or serverless services)
* Monitor network performance and troubleshoot network issues proactively, such as outages, latency, and packet loss.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design and implement network solutions that meet business requirements.
* Act as expert advisor to both internal and clients’ IT team to address connectivity and security issues; provide technical support and guidance to end\-users and other IT staff.
* Work with cloud providers, hardware and software vendors and ISPs (internet service providers) to implement and support complex networks (multi\-cloud, hybrid, low power, wireless) as required by business case
* Respond to network emergencies and troubleshoot as needed
* Document network configurations, processes, procedures and known issues and resolutions, drive continuous improvement in addressing known issues quickly
* Support the networking related scope for standard industry audits and certifications (e.g. ISO, GMP, GDPR, etc.)
* Open to travel (50\-60%) to client locations during requirements phase, implementation and trouble shooting
* Stay informed with the latest networking technologies and best practices


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Previous experience as a Network Engineer or in a similar role; 5 or more years of relevant experience
* Strong understanding of networking protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, MQTT, and SNMP.
* Good to have knowledge of OT (operations technology) network protocols such as OPC UA, OPC DA, Modbus, Profibus, point\-to\-point networks, etc., and OT network storage devices such as NVR/DVR
* Hands\-on experience with network equipment from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, and Palo Alto Networks.
* Good to have: Knowledge of IOT platforms, platforms such as Rockwell, Honeywell, PTC Kepware, Litmus, Crosser etc.
* Experience with network monitoring and management tools, such as Wireshark, Nagios, and SolarWinds.
* Solid understanding of network security principles and best practices.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or JNCIA.
* Experience with cloud networking platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform and in connecting on\-premises systems (Edge computers, data centres and Low Power IOT devises)
* Knowledge of software\-defined networking (SDN) technologies.
* Experience with scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell for automation tasks.
